screens.help:
Help

Quick:
• /best <category> — best card for a category
• /quickadd <bank>: <category> <%>, … — add a bank in one line
• /top — category ranking
• /banks — my banks
• /settings — language & notifications
• /home — main menu, /cancel — cancel the current flow

Free text:
• "where is better for restaurants" — best card answer
• "delete bank T-Bank", "delete category fuel"
• "Fuel 5%" — add a line during manual input

From any Telegram chat type @cashback_analyzer_bot <category> — instant recommendation.
